title: 11-Stop Walking Tour - Quick Summary
items: My walking tour, Berlin Then and Now, covers **11 stops and 16 places from Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt**, through the city's medieval, Prussian and Cold War layers.
The route is **about 3 km and about 2.5 hours**, mostly flat. Every stop has time for the archive photo and your questions.
At every stop I hold up **an archive photo of the same place**: the TV Tower, St. Mary's Church, the Humboldt Forum, the Berliner Dom and Museum Island, then and now.
Unlike most Berlin tours that start at the Brandenburg Gate, this route covers **the oldest part of Berlin**, where the city was actually founded.
The walk costs **€25 per person**, with no more than 10 people. Meet at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz at 12:30. **Book your date at walkofberlin.com.**
